title: A 2% budget lands in the middle of a tie
caption: Sonnet 5.5's 40 most suspicious honest programs out of 500, one square each, labelled with its score. Top row: the default 0 to 10 score. Bottom row: the same monitor asked for 0 to 100. Amber squares are tied at the cutoff, so a budget can take all of them or none.
notes: The four-row version (Sonnet and Haiku, both scales) is P13 in the appendix. Haiku's 0 to 10 tie is worse: 221 programs share one score.
